column1: # english-ai.tsv: English -> Odia, written by Claude (Anthropic) for this project
# (2026-11-03, owner: "an extensive addition of common English to Odia words ... use
# your own trained corpus"). From its own knowledge of Odia; not copied from any
# dictionary. Every Odia word was checked against the app's word lists (IndicCorp top
# 100k, the lexicon, the meanings layers): tools/eval/english-words-check.py.
# Licence: MIT (this project). Status: AI-written, not yet checked by a native speaker;
# shown after the curated english.tsv entries and labelled as such.
# Format: english <TAB> odia options, "|"-separated, the everyday word first.
#   english  lowercase a-z, space, hyphen, apostrophe (a word or a short phrase)
#   odia     canonical (nukta decomposed); a word or a short phrase
